scope: original 300 items; one large truck; L4; chain_area_v1
method: existing restricted columns and fragile caps, with pressure-dependent column counts and insertion checks
stop: complete fixed grid or total budget; no adaptive restarts; a validation error stops the run
validation: export and reread complete layouts; exact thresholds and separate floating referee at requested parameters; partial layouts checked with subset identities
interpretation: verified complete one-large witness plus existing volume/cost lower bounds closes both objectives; failure or timeout only leaves original problem unknown
comparison: development on known instance, not a fair multi-algorithm comparison or AI efficiency experiment
preregistration: written before production change and first search run; not a third-party immutable registration
